note: The question bank for /discovery/. The MASTER of record is the vault page '406 Front Desk — Problem-Discovery Questionnaire'; this file is its self-serve deployment, never a fork. `ghl` names a shared custom-field KEY (never an id: ids come from src/_data/discoveryFields.json, which scripts/sync-discovery.mjs generates from the live API). `exact: true` means the GHL field is a picklist and the option strings here must match it character for character, which the sync script asserts.

steps.title: You and the one thing
steps.blurb: The only step that is required. Everything after this is optional, and you can send what you have at any point.

questions.label: Your name
Business name
Best email
questions.help: Where your answers and my read on them get sent. No phone number needed.

questions.label: Your role
Who else weighs in on a decision like this?
options: Me and a partner or spouse

questions.label: Which of these sound like your business?
questions.help: Tap all that fit. It decides which questions you see later.
options: We have a storefront or shop floor
We go out to the customer
We're a clinic or handle health information

questions.label: If one thing came off your plate tomorrow, what would it be?
questions.help: One line is plenty. Everything else on this form hangs off this answer.

steps.title: Where your week goes
steps.blurb: Not the work you do for customers. The work around it.
